name: AD/PD 2027, 21st International Conference on Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Diseases
description: AD/PD is a biennial hybrid conference covering advances in science and therapy for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and related neurodegenerative disorders. The 2027 edition is the 21st in the series and is expected to draw about 5000 delegates.
